name: Peer Support Circles
description: Small, guided groups where young people talk openly about anxiety, depression and everyday stress.
details: Circles meet weekly for about an hour and are led by trained facilitators. Groups are matched by age (13 to 17 and 18 to 24).

name: School Programmes
description: Workshops and talks that bring mental health education into classrooms.
details: Programmes run for one to four sessions and cover stress, bullying, healthy habits and how to ask for help. Schools book about a month ahead.

name: Referral Counselling
description: Connections to qualified counsellors who understand what it is like to be young today.
details: We match you with a registered counsellor near you or online. Some counsellors offer reduced rates, and referrals happen within about two weeks.

name: Parent and Teacher Guidance
description: Guidance on recognising the signs and starting the conversation.
details: Short online sessions and printable guides for parents, teachers and caregivers.
